# dsh-plugins
Personal out-of-tree plugins for dsh (DeepSeek Harness), installable through the community plugin fl
ow (`dsh plugin add`).
> **Note:** these plugins require my fork of DeepSeek Harness — they build and run against APIs in t
he fork, not the upstream `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` release.
## Plugins
| Plugin | Description |
| `dsh-vim-plugin` | Vim modal editing for the Web GUI composer: NORMAL/INSERT/VISUAL modes, a block
caret, motions, operators, and a mode badge. |
